title: Characterization of finite-set erasure
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $i$ be an element of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $S$ and $A$ be subsets of that finite index set. Then deleting $i$ from $S$ yields $A$ if and only if $i\notin A$ and either $S=A$ or $S=A\cup\{i\}$.
